title: IEEE Publication: Hardware Trojan Detection
text: Sai published a peer-reviewed IEEE conference paper titled 'Hardware Trojan Detection with Machine Learning and Power Side-Channels: A Post-Deployment Analysis' at IEEE CNS 2025.
